name: Proto.io
description_en:
Proto.io is a product in the UX design category. Its directory profile covers User Research, User Journeys, Usability Testing, Prototyping, For Websites, For Mobile, Animation.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $24.00.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: create motion or animated visual elements. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
